item.title: Factory
item.description: Factory’s shared intent is separating creation from use. The three variants — Factory Method, Abstract Factory, and Static Factory Method — split creation differently and suit different conditions. Static Factory Method is the variant most often encountered in practice, and DI containers absorb part of Factory’s explicit role.
